question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

He was ______ at his brother’s refusal to help him financially.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Indignant.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is talking about **someone who felt anger at his brother's refusal to help**.
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank is '**Indignant**'.
 
• Also, the use of the word ''refusal'' in the sentence indicates the use of the word 'indignant' in the blank.
 
• The word 'Indignant' means **Feeling or showing anger or annoyance at what is perceived as unfair treatment**.
 
 
• Example:* I was **indignant** because I felt that I had been punished unfairly*.

 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Complete Sentence: *He was indignant at his brother’s refusal to help him financially*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let us explore the other options:

 
 
• **Indicted** means **To officially charge somebody with a crime (किसी पर अपराध के लिए औपचारिक रूप से अभियोग लगाना; अभ्‍यारोपण करना)**.
 
• **Enchanted** means **To fill someone with great delight; charm ((कहानियों में) जादुई शक्तियों से प्रभावित)**.
 
• **Enamoured** means To** ****be filled with love for someone (मोहित)**.
